name: Temptation Retaliate
source:
A teacher whose class devolved into chaos from the actions of a certain girl
takes hardcore sex revenge using a hypnosis app on his cell phone.

Whether it's in the middle of a lesson, after school, on the way to campus or during 4th period break, Shiiba has his way with problem girl Ayane.

- Keitai App
The cell phone application that Shiiba uses to cause hypnotism.

- Ayane Arisugawa
Daughter of the board chairman and the cause of all Shiiba's grief

[From: [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106227.html]DLsite English[/url]]
